Then qualified 4th. Classic Hamilton. #F1 #SpanishGP #Ferrari

**Key Facts (Confidence: HIGH — multiple independent sources):**
- Hamilton locked up under braking at Turn 22 (final corner) in FP3
- Hit barriers; front wing wedged under car; front right tyre punctured
- Reversed out; ignored Ferrari's instruction to stop; tried to drive back to pits (~1 full lap)
- Eventually stopped on track; red flag called
- Ollie Bearman ALSO crashed in FP3 (separate incident)
- Hamilton was P4 at time of crash (Antonelli led FP3, Leclerc P2)
- Recovered to qualify P4 in Q3 (+0.189s off Norris)

stories.title: Madring Debut — Madrid's F1 History Returns

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
The last F1 race in the Madrid area was the 1981 Spanish Grand Prix at Jarama.

45 years later, Madring hosted its first Formula 1 race.

22 corners, 2 tunnels, and a 550-metre banked corner called La Monumental.

Madrid is back. #F1 #SpanishGP
